name: Tagamanent (Spain)
description: Lozengy of yellow and black, with twenty-seven black pieces.
history: The flag was approved on 30 July 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3479 of 25 September 2001; its origin is heraldic, from the arms of Tagamanent, an oblong flag of 2:3 lozengy of yellow and twenty-seven black pieces.

features.role: lozengy of yellow and twenty-seven black pieces
